item.text: The SVG is saved: a checked envelope floats four pixels over a seven-second loop, with a pause between movements. It also adapts to dark mode and stays still when reduced motion is enabled. I’m checking the file now.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('caught-up.svg')
r = ET.parse(p).getroot()
assert r.attrib['viewBox'] == '0 0 160 128'
assert r.find('{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}title').text == \"You're all caught up\"
assert 'prefers-reduced-motion: reduce' in p.read_text()
print(f'Valid SVG XML, {p.stat().st_size:,} bytes; accessible title and reduced-motion fallback present.')
PY"
